a gente não tá jogando o jogo das startups de powerpoint.

a gente roda transação real, alto volume, e tá construindo o que vem depois das adquirentes.

agora chegou a hora de reforçar o time com um dev back-end pleno que já tenha vivido o caos e a pressão de fintech , que entenda o que é rodar sistema crítico em ambiente produtivo e queira fazer parte de uma empresa que entrega, não só fala.

o que você vai fazer

  • desenvolver e evoluir a infraestrutura core da reborn: checkout, subadquirência, split, antifraude, liquidação e conciliação.
  • desenhar e implementar serviços robustos e escaláveis pra sustentar bilhões em volume transacionado.
  • criar integrações com adquirentes, gateways e PSPs, além de novos módulos internos da nossa stack.
  • trabalhar lado a lado com produto, ops e compliance, entregando features com impacto direto no volume e rentabilidade da empresa.
  • participar de decisões arquiteturais que definem o futuro da plataforma (infra distribuída, mensageria, escalabilidade, performance).

stack e ambiente

Java 

Spring

React

Full-stack

AWS

IAC

git

REST

(plus se tiver)

  • background em fintech (subadquirência, gateway, PSP, banco digital, etc.)
  • noções sólidas de antifraude, liquidação e conciliação financeira
  • vivência com alto volume transacional e requisitos de segurança (PCI-DSS, LGPD, etc.)

quem estamos procurando

  • dev pleno com pelo menos 3 anos de experiência real em back-end , e passagem comprovada por fintech ou empresa financeira
  • alguém que entende que performance não é só métrica — é reputação
  • mente curiosa, perfil executor e sangue-frio pra lidar com sistemas de missão crítica
  • capacidade de pensar arquitetura, mas também de entregar rápido e limpo
  • vontade de crescer dentro de uma fintech que tá se tornando referência no mercado

por que a reborn

  • empresa real: operação rodando, milhares de sellers, milhões processados diariamente
  • autonomia total, zero política, entregas rápidas
  • ambiente de alto desempenho, com cultura de dono e foco em resultado
  • oportunidade de crescer junto com o core do produto e influenciar diretamente o roadmap técnico

detalhes

  • modelo: 100% remoto
  • faixa: compatível com o mercado
  • contratação: PJ
  • horário: Integral
  • stack moderna, produto crítico, impacto direto

envia teu GitHub, LinkedIn e/ou portfólio  pra 

 com o assunto

 (Dev Back-end Pleno — Reborn)

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Palestrante
description:
Descrição da Empresa Empresa sem fins lucrativos que visa democratizar os conhecimentos em tecnologia.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de um Palestrante voluntário para se juntar à nossa equipe na DemocratizaTech. Este cargo envolve a realização de palestras virtuais, sessões de treinamento e workshops educativos. O candidato selecionado será responsável por criar e apresentar conteúdos motivacionais e educacionais para diferentes audiências, promovendo o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional dos participantes. Este é um cargo de voluntário e será realizado remotamente.

Qualificações

  • Coaching de Vida: Experiência em coaching de vida para auxiliar os participantes no desenvolvimento de suas habilidades pessoais e profissionais.
  • Falar em Público: Habilidades sólidas em falar em público, com capacidade de engajar e inspirar diferentes tipos de audiência.
  • Treinamento e Educação: Experiência em treinamento, ensino e desenvolvimento de materiais educacionais.
  • Também será considerado um diferencial possuir formação em áreas relacionadas à educação, comunicação ou psicologia, além de ter flexibilidade para trabalhar remotamente.

title: Recruiter – LATAM (Remote)
description:
GrowthAssistant is looking for an experienced Recruiter for LATAM to join our growing team!


In this role, you’ll manage the end-to-end recruitment process — from creating job postings to sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing hires. You’ll work closely with hiring managers to ensure a smooth and efficient hiring experience for candidates and internal teams alike.


As we’re a fast-paced startup , you’ll wear multiple hats and contribute beyond traditional recruitment — from supporting process documentation to working within our CMS. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who’s resourceful, proactive, and eager to learn new things.


What You’ll Do

  • Create and publish job ads across various job boards and social media platforms.
  • Source and network with potential candidates through platforms like LinkedIn, Indeed, Facebook, and OnlineJobs.
  • Collaborate with hiring managers to define qualification criteria and hiring needs.
  • Screen resumes and applications to build strong candidate pipelines.
  • Conduct initial interviews and create shortlists of qualified candidates.
  • Maintain consistent candidate communication throughout the hiring process.
  • Manage and update the candidate database for future opportunities.
  • Support documentation of recruitment processes and best practices as needed.


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience as a Recruitment Specialist, Recruiter , or similar role.
  • Strong background hiring for Digital Marketing Assistants/Associates or Social Media roles .
  • Proficient in sourcing techniques on social media and professional job sites.
  • Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) .
  • Excellent English communication skills — written and spoken.
  • Demonstrated experience handling high-volume recruitment for managerial and executive-level positions.
  • Comfortable working with US-based and off-shore clients .
  • A self-starter who can work independently and figure things out with minimal direction.


Nice to Have

  • Experience working within a startup environment .
  • Exposure to CMS tools or documentation platforms.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

At GrowthAssistant, you’ll collaborate with a diverse, talented team, sharpen your skills with global clients, and make an impact in your career. We value your growth and recognize your contributions every step of the way.


Apply today and take the next step in your career with GrowthAssistant!

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
Estamos em busca de um/a profissional que acima de tudo tenha atitude e comprometimento com a busca de resultados! 


Você é movido/a por desafios e busca uma oportunidade de alto impacto no mercado financeiro?


Se respondeu sim à pergunta anterior, queremos você para ser um/a profissional para integrar nossa equipe comercial e atuar na comercialização do nosso produto de investimento, um produto financeiro diferenciado, em plena expansão, que vem transformando a experiência de investimento dos clientes e que gera ótima rentabilidade para o investidor e altos ganhos para você. 


Se você tem pensamento empreendedor, gosta de construir relacionamentos e quer crescimento profissional e financeiro, em um ambiente dinâmico, essa vaga é para você!


Atividades


• Trabalhar na captação de recursos para composição de carteira;

• Manutenção e zelo com os clientes captados;

• Atuar no relacionamento e atendimento consultivo, entendendo as necessidades do cliente;

• Apresentar e comercializar o produto de forma clara, transparente e convincente;

• Participar de reuniões, eventos e treinamentos voltados à performance comercial;

• Contribuir ativamente para a expansão e fortalecimento da marca no mercado.



Experiência desejada:


• Vivência anterior em vendas (preferencialmente no setor financeiro, seguros, investimentos ou produtos de alta renda);

• Serâ considerado um diferencial ter passagem em bancos, bancos de investimentos ou como assessor de plataformas de investimentos;

• Habilidade em negociação e fechamento de negócios;

• Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;

• Perfil proativo, resiliente e orientado para resultados;

• Desejável carteira de clientes ativa (será um ótimo diferencial);

• Além das habilidades acima, será um diferencial a formação em Economia, Administração ou áreas correlatas, bem como certificações como CFP ou similar.



Remuneração:


• Nosso modelo de remuneração é integralmente linkado à resultados e é superior ao mercado;

• Modelo competitivo de ganhos;

• Oportunidade de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional;


Você terá também:


• Treinamento completo sobre o produto e suporte para maximizar resultados;

• Atuação em um mercado em expansão, com grande potencial de ganhos;

• Possibilidade de fazer investimentos próprios com rentabilidade muito elevadas e bem acima dos produtos de mercado;



Local de trabalho: home office

Tipo de contrato: a definir conforme perfil do candidato.


Se interessou? Se candidate e venha fazer parte dessa jornada de crescimento conosco.

title: AI Staff Engineer (Remote)
description:
AI Staff EngineerWe are a collective group of fearless people with a clear purpose: to empower professionals around the world through intelligent workflow automation software. Currently, more than 500 people across 7 countries work with us, remotely or in a hybrid way, to make life easier for over 3,000 companies using Pipefy in more than 180 countries. Since our founding in 2015, we have put people at the center of everything we do, so we invite you to learn more about this position and apply to be part of our team.


You’ll be responsible for empowering users to make the productivity revolution happen in their companies.


As an AI Developer at Pipefy, your mission is to leverage AI to solve user problems proactively! It can be programming a new feature, polishing existing features, supporting a team member, giving feedback, or solving a bug. Your role is crucial in driving our AI capabilities forward.


You'll have the opportunity to conduct and participate in experiments, make suggestions to improve our architecture and product and use tons of data to make the best decisions.


Since we are fully remote, you'll meet and work with people from all around the world.


One paragraph resume about what people can expect from working in this position (Mission in the role, responsibilities, seniority and what profile we are looking for).


Main Responsibilities:


- Develop new features from start to finish: through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance, as well as improve existing ones, focusing on AI-driven functionalities.

- Take responsibility for the system quality by driving testability together with architects and QAs to ensure that the way we design our platform enables controllability and automation.

- Take responsibility for system stability, ensuring proper testing and observability, actively monitoring production behavior, and reacting quickly to incidents.

- Share knowledge with the team and learn together. We believe knowledge is much more valuable when shared, so we’re always learning and teaching each other.

- Take part in the continuous improvement of Engineering processes, like recruiting, hiring, onboarding, documentation, incidents, tech talks, etc.

- Sought out for technical guidance on your squad and related ones, anticipate technical issues at the product level, and make architectural and design decisions to avoid them.

- Consistently reduce the complexity of projects, systems, and processes to get more done with less work. Breaks up deliverables to optimize for earlier feedback and incremental delivery of business value.

- Help the team develop a more robust engineering culture focused on quality and impactful deliveries by setting an example and mentorship.

- Identify and proactively create projects to fix Pipefy's architecture when preconditions change and current architecture is not optimal/fit anymore, extracting and documenting platforms whenever necessary.


Requirements:


- Write correct, clean code with periodic guidance; consistently follows best practices, including tests (unit, functional, integration).

- Exceptional proficiency in Python, LLM applications and AI model integration.

- Design and develop code to provide an integrated and managed development life cycle for traditional and generative ML applications.

- Experience using LLM-based frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph and others.

- Experience in implementing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems and working with vector databases.

- Have practical knowledge about infrastructure, service architectures, tools, libraries, frameworks, continuous integration, and continuous deployment systems.

- Able to seamlessly learn and guide others across large sections of our codebase.

- Actively contributes to the technical design of features.

- Understand and make well-reasoned design tradeoffs in their area.

- Strong ability with RESTful.


Bonus point:


- Experience in fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs.

- Infrastructure: Cloud Computing, AWS, Networks, Load Balancers, Web Servers, Containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, Disaster Recovery, Monitoring.

- Experience with document processing and data extraction pipelines.

- Experience with GraphQL apis.

- You have a sharp eye for UX/UI, and you work user-centered.

- Experience with different types of methodologies and tools for Unit, Integration and End to End testing.

- Have good communication in oral and written English.

- Experience working on agile and lean methodologies.

- Experience building and scaling complex, high-performance, high-transaction applications.


Benefits:


- Health and Dental Plan

- Individual Life Insurance

- Flexible Hours (in compliance with daily work hours)

- Flexible Meal/Food Allowance

- Home Office Support

- Furniture Assistance

- Psychological Support (for you or legal dependents)

- Wellhub

- Extended Maternity and Paternity Leave

- School/Nanny Allowance

- Supplemental Nutrition Assistance

- Veterinary Plan

- Birthday Day Off

- Marriage Leave (7 days)

- Bereavement Leave for Loved Ones (10 days)

- Bereavement Leave for Adoption or Pet Loss (2 days)

- Individual Funeral Assistance

- Monthly Education Support

- Payroll Loan

- Financial Consulting

- Udemy Corporate Access

- Coworking Space

- Pipefy License for up to 10 Users

title: AI Staff Engineer (Remote)
description:
AI Staff EngineerWe are a collective group of fearless people with a clear purpose: to empower professionals around the world through intelligent workflow automation software. Currently, more than 500 people across 7 countries work with us, remotely or in a hybrid way, to make life easier for over 3,000 companies using Pipefy in more than 180 countries. Since our founding in 2015, we have put people at the center of everything we do, so we invite you to learn more about this position and apply to be part of our team.


You’ll be responsible for empowering users to make the productivity revolution happen in their companies.


As an AI Developer at Pipefy, your mission is to leverage AI to solve user problems proactively! It can be programming a new feature, polishing existing features, supporting a team member, giving feedback, or solving a bug. Your role is crucial in driving our AI capabilities forward.


You'll have the opportunity to conduct and participate in experiments, make suggestions to improve our architecture and product and use tons of data to make the best decisions.


Since we are fully remote, you'll meet and work with people from all around the world.


One paragraph resume about what people can expect from working in this position (Mission in the role, responsibilities, seniority and what profile we are looking for).


Main Responsibilities:


- Develop new features from start to finish: through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance, as well as improve existing ones, focusing on AI-driven functionalities.

- Take responsibility for the system quality by driving testability together with architects and QAs to ensure that the way we design our platform enables controllability and automation.

- Take responsibility for system stability, ensuring proper testing and observability, actively monitoring production behavior, and reacting quickly to incidents.

- Share knowledge with the team and learn together. We believe knowledge is much more valuable when shared, so we’re always learning and teaching each other.

- Take part in the continuous improvement of Engineering processes, like recruiting, hiring, onboarding, documentation, incidents, tech talks, etc.

- Sought out for technical guidance on your squad and related ones, anticipate technical issues at the product level, and make architectural and design decisions to avoid them.

- Consistently reduce the complexity of projects, systems, and processes to get more done with less work. Breaks up deliverables to optimize for earlier feedback and incremental delivery of business value.

- Help the team develop a more robust engineering culture focused on quality and impactful deliveries by setting an example and mentorship.

- Identify and proactively create projects to fix Pipefy's architecture when preconditions change and current architecture is not optimal/fit anymore, extracting and documenting platforms whenever necessary.


Requirements:


- Write correct, clean code with periodic guidance; consistently follows best practices, including tests (unit, functional, integration).

- Exceptional proficiency in Python, LLM applications and AI model integration.

- Design and develop code to provide an integrated and managed development life cycle for traditional and generative ML applications.

- Experience using LLM-based frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph and others.

- Experience in implementing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems and working with vector databases.

- Have practical knowledge about infrastructure, service architectures, tools, libraries, frameworks, continuous integration, and continuous deployment systems.

- Able to seamlessly learn and guide others across large sections of our codebase.

- Actively contributes to the technical design of features.

- Understand and make well-reasoned design tradeoffs in their area.

- Strong ability with RESTful.


Bonus point:


- Experience in fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs.

- Infrastructure: Cloud Computing, AWS, Networks, Load Balancers, Web Servers, Containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, Disaster Recovery, Monitoring.

- Experience with document processing and data extraction pipelines.

- Experience with GraphQL apis.

- You have a sharp eye for UX/UI, and you work user-centered.

- Experience with different types of methodologies and tools for Unit, Integration and End to End testing.

- Have good communication in oral and written English.

- Experience working on agile and lean methodologies.

- Experience building and scaling complex, high-performance, high-transaction applications.


Benefits:


- Health and Dental Plan

- Individual Life Insurance

- Flexible Hours (in compliance with daily work hours)

- Flexible Meal/Food Allowance

- Home Office Support

- Furniture Assistance

- Psychological Support (for you or legal dependents)

- Wellhub

- Extended Maternity and Paternity Leave

- School/Nanny Allowance

- Supplemental Nutrition Assistance

title: Analista Treinamento e Desenvolvimento Pleno/Senior
description:
Estamos em busca de Analista de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento Pleno/Sênior para integrar o time de Performance e Cultura da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL. Essa posição tem como propósito impulsionar o desenvolvimento das pessoas e fortalecer a cultura organizacional em um ambiente dinâmico, inovador e orientado a resultados. Você será responsável por desenhar e implementar iniciativas estratégicas de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento, apoiar programas de performance e liderança, e atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Mapear e analisar necessidades de treinamento junto às lideranças e áreas de negócio;
  • Planejar, estruturar e executar programas de desenvolvimento técnico, comportamental e de liderança;
  • Desenvolver conteúdos e trilhas de aprendizagem (presenciais, online e híbridos);
  • Gerenciar indicadores e relatórios de eficácia dos programas de T&D;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de gestão de performance, plano de desenvolvimento individual (PDI) e sucessão;
  • Conduzir trilhas de desenvolvimento de carreira
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) de RH, contribuindo para o fortalecimento da cultura organizacional e do engajamento das equipes.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Formação superior completa em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos, Pedagogia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia sólida em Treinamento e Desenvolvimento,
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de aprendizagem, gestão por competências e ferramentas de avaliação;
  • Experiência com desenho instrucional e facilitação de treinamentos;
  • Domínio de ferramentas digitais de aprendizagem e plataformas LMS;
  • Habilidade para análise de indicadores e elaboração de planos de ação.
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para conversação.




A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. title: Desenvolvedor Sênior/ Tech Lead
description:
Sobre a FourD :

Nosso propósito é apoiar nossos clientes na implementação de produtos financeiros e em melhorias de jornadas. Trabalhamos com NuBank, Banco Next e Natura Pay...


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com .NET Core / ASP.NET.
  • Domínio de C#, APIs RESTful e padrões como DTOs.
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de APIs (ApiVersioning, rotas versionadas).
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais.
  • Domínio em Git e controle de versão.
  • Experiência com integração de APIs, sistemas externos e micro serviços.
  • Boa comunicação e adaptabilidade a diferentes projetos e linguagens.
  • Experiência com autenticação/autorização (JWT, OAuth2)
  • Vivência com testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas e manipulação de dados externos.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com arquitetura limpa (Clean Architecture) e arquitetura hexagonal
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento, logging e observabilidade (Serilog, Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana).
  • Familiaridade com mensageria (AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Kafka, RabbitMQ) e padrões como Circuit Breaker e Retry.
  • Experiência com gestão de secrets e configuração segura em ambientes diversos.

title: Accounting Specialist (Remote from Brazil)
description:
About Us

We’re a Boston-based real estate company seeking a detail-oriented accounting professional fluent in English to support our CFO with bookkeeping, financial reporting, and analysis. This remote role is based in Brazil and requires daily communication in English via Zoom and chat.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create and manage QuickBooks invoices, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Categorize receipts and expenses; prepare monthly financial reports
  • Maintain spreadsheets for rental and mortgage tracking
  • Assist with budgets, financial models, and investor proposals
  • Provide accurate financial data and support the CFO on accounting projects
  • Manage compliance documentation by reviewing transaction files for accuracy and submitting documents for approval


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of accounting or bookkeeping experience
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks (or other accounting software and willingness to learn)
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets (or Excel and willingness to learn Google Sheets)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken); all work and meetings are in English
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable managing multiple priorities
  • Reliable internet connection for Zoom and cloud systems
  • Available Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM Eastern (Boston time zone)


Compensation

  • Full-time, R$7,000/month
  • Remote from Brazil
  • Reports to: Chief Financial Officer (Boston HQ)


How to Apply

Please submit your application through LinkedIn with your resume in English .

Applications that are not in English will not be reviewed...because the reviewer only speaks English. ;)

title: Accounting Specialist (Remote from Brazil)
description:
About Us

We’re a Boston-based real estate company seeking a detail-oriented accounting professional fluent in English to support our CFO with bookkeeping, financial reporting, and analysis. This remote role is based in Brazil and requires daily communication in English via Zoom and chat.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create and manage QuickBooks invoices, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Categorize receipts and expenses; prepare monthly financial reports
  • Maintain spreadsheets for rental and mortgage tracking
  • Assist with budgets, financial models, and investor proposals
  • Provide accurate financial data and support the CFO on accounting projects
  • Manage compliance documentation by reviewing transaction files for accuracy and submitting documents for approval


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of accounting or bookkeeping experience
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks (or other accounting software and willingness to learn)
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets (or Excel and willingness to learn Google Sheets)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken); all work and meetings are in English
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable managing multiple priorities
  • Reliable internet connection for Zoom and cloud systems
  • Available Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM Eastern (Boston time zone)


Compensation

  • Full-time, R$7,000/month
  • Remote from Brazil
  • Reports to: Chief Financial Officer (Boston HQ)


How to Apply

Please submit your application through LinkedIn with your resume in English .

Applications that are not in English will not be reviewed...because the reviewer only speaks English. ;)

title: Case Manager (Project Manager)
description:
Job description


U.S. Immigration Law Firm, Law offices of Jacob J Sapochnick is growing and developing law firm in the USA that specializes in business, employment, investment, and family immigration to the USA. The law firm is known for providing its best to the clients by offering creative and strategic legal solutions. We are looking for the new team member, case manager to join our team.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Communicate with client - Client communication and excellent customer service is key at the Law Office of Jacob Sapochnick
  • Serving as primary point of contact for clients , conducting initial meetings with clients, explain immigration process, requirements, providing regular updates on the case.
  • Document Collection - Review and analyze client documents. Assemble cases for filing, prepare and organize exhibits.
  • Ensure that clients understand the strategy and steps of the process and lead status updates calls with clients.
  • Be proactive and raising any issues that might delay the petition and report it to attorney and senior legal specialists.
  • Reviewing documentation provided by clients and make sure that client has been informed about all missing documents in advance.
  • Working closely with senior legal specialists and U.S. attorneys to understand the strategy of the case and make sure it is implemented and making sure that the petition is ready in advance for the mid and final reviews of the attorney and that cases are submitted timely.



Requirements:

· Excellent communication skills, grammar, spelling, and written English composition skills is a must.


· B.A. Degree in Law or English or related studies student or graduate.


· Previous legal or immigration experience preferred.


· High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and excellent proofreading skills.


· Strong organizational skills; ability to work under pressure, work within competing deadlines, and prioritize workload effectively.


· Be comfortable with phone calls and video calls.


· Applicant must have the ability to use MS Excel, MS Outlook, MS Word, MS PowerPoint, Adobe Acrobat Professional.


Compensation: $ - $ / monthly + regular bonuses


Schedule:

  • 8-hour shift,
  • Monday to Friday
  • Remote work or office work

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Motion Web Designer
description:
About you:

As a Motion Web Designer, you’ll play a central role in shaping visually compelling and accessible web experiences that balance aesthetics with functionality.


You bring to the team the following competencies:

  • 8+ years of experience in creative or visual design roles, ideally in digital environments.
  • Mastery of Lottie Files and light motion design for icons and interactive elements.
  • Familiarity with Figma for crafting responsive web designs.
  • Experience creating and editing video content for hero sections, homepage banners, or other dynamic assets.
  • Strong understanding of ADA compliance principles for web accessibility:
  • Ability to adapt and recycle pre-approved design elements while maintaining consistency and accessibility.
  • A refined eye for layout, typography, color, and visual hierarchy .
  • Basic understanding of UI and usability principles to ensure function supports form.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design visually impactful, ADA-compliant landing pages and UI components using Figma.
  • Create and repurpose video and animated content for web use—especially in homepage hero sections and brand touchpoints.
  • Skillfully recycle and modify pre-approved design elements, ensuring all changes remain compliant and consistent with brand standards.
  • Maintain a consistent visual language across all digital assets, aligned with brand guidelines.
  • Work collaboratively with marketing and dev teams to implement design updates and assets efficiently.
  • Propose creative design solutions that align with usability, performance, and accessibility requirements.
  • Stay up to date with trends in motion design, UI design, and digital accessibility standards.


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: PMO - brazil
description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa com propósito? Fazer acontecer inspirando o melhor das pessoas está no DNA da nossa gente.


Prezamos por pessoas que:

• Buscam comprometimento e excelência em suas entregas;

• Criam e disseminam um ambiente colaborativo, com espírito de equipe, onde a amizade é valorizada;

• Queiram atuar com profissionais de confiança;

• E acreditam que o respeito e a humildade são essenciais para o seu dia a dia aqui na Numen.


Se você se identifica com tudo isso e quer ser Numen, não perca a oportunidade de participar desse processo seletivo!


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência na construção e acompanhamento de KPIs de projetos e na elaboração de planos de comunicação.
  • Vivência em projetos de implementação e integração SAP.
  • Inglês avançado para interação com times multiculturais.


Diferencial:

  • Participação em projetos com responsabilidade sobre o processo de migração de dados e garantia de integridade entre sistemas.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Apoiar a rotina diária de gestão de projetos, garantindo o acompanhamento de cronogramas, escopo, riscos, orçamento e entregas.
  • Consolidar informações e status dos projetos, preparando relatórios executivos e painéis de controle (dashboards) com indicadores de desempenho (KPIs).
  • Dar suporte na comunicação entre as equipes do projeto, assegurando o alinhamento entre as partes envolvidas e a atualização das informações nos canais oficiais.
  • Acompanhar planos de ação e pendências, auxiliando os responsáveis no cumprimento dos prazos e metas estabelecidos.
  • Organizar reuniões de acompanhamento, registrando atas, decisões e pontos de atenção.
  • Contribuir para a padronização de processos e metodologias de gestão de projetos, promovendo boas práticas de governança.
  • Monitorar entregáveis e apoiar a preparação de auditorias ou revisões de qualidade.
  • Colaborar com as lideranças e PMs na identificação de riscos, oportunidades de melhoria e otimização dos processos de gestão.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS


  • Procuramos um(a) profissional com perfil dinâmico(a), flexível e colaborativo(a), que se sinta à vontade em um ambiente de múltiplos projetos e demandas simultâneas, mantendo foco em qualidade, entrega e parceria com o cliente.
  • Contratação efetiva por tempo indeterminado.
  • Atuação 100% Remota.


BENEFÍCIOS


  • Vale transporte
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Swile Shop
  • TotalPass
  • Vittude
  • Assistência Médica Sulamérica
  • Assistência Odonto Sulamérica
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Benefício para filhos PCD
  • Previdência Privada
  • Numen School
  • Parcerias educacionais com FIA, FIAP, Moovi, Wise Up e English Pass.

title: Trilingual Technical Support Analyst
description:
InvGate is a fast growing SaaS company that develops products for IT management and service automation, used by clients in over 60 countries in industries such as banking, e-commerce, education and technology.


To support our continuous growth we are looking for a Trilingual Technical Support Analyst to join our team.


Some of the role's responsibilities include providing technical and functional support to clients worldwide through different channels such as email, tickets, and remote sessions (Teamviewer/Zoom/etc), checking clients' configurations, suggesting improvements and best practices to maximize the platform's efficiency, and working closely with the development and customer success teams to troubleshoot issues.


Do not hesitate to apply if you…


  • are fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese (native-level portuguese strongly preffered, C1 level is the minimum required)
  • enjoy working with clients, providing top-level support
  • think analytically
  • have strong communication and troubleshooting skills
  • have previous experience in technical support for software and/or infrastructure
  • are tech-savvy


Having previous experience using InvGate products is a big plus!


We offer real opportunities for professional development, fully covered English classes, technical training both in-house and at educational centers, top-tier health insurance, a fixed amount for purchases in the food sector, reimbursement for remote work, and extended vacation and paternity leave.

title: .NET UI Developer with Blazor Hybrid
description:
Hey, Dev, check the opportunity we have here at Brick Abode!


About Brick Abode


We are a software development company that serves clients from multiple countries around the world, with differing technological needs. Therefore, we value a good computer science base.


Contractors with a solid understanding of the basic building blocks of today’s technology are really welcome and thrive at Brick Abode.


People here are given autonomy, not put into a box to work only on one thing. They are in touch with the business needs of our clients, sometimes communicating with them directly.


We challenge ourselves to learn new things and go outside our comfort zone. Candidates who are up to the challenge will have an amazing career with us.


If you feel that your values fit with Brick Abode culture, check below for further details about this Position.


What kind of professional are we looking for?


We’re looking for a responsible and proactive professional who can navigate between technology and business contexts with ease, feel comfortable in fast-paced environments, and have great communication skills.

Our team is Brazil and USA-based, and communication is in English. The position is fully remote.



What do I need to have to apply for this position?


  • ASP.NET
  • .NET Core 9
  • Rich UI development in Blazor
  • Proven experience with Web development and the use of REST APIs
  • Working knowledge of Blazor Hybrid (WinForms Blazor)
  • Working knowledge of MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) for better code separation and maintainability
  • Working knowledge of Secure applications using OAuth, JWT, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
  • Advanced or Fluent English
  • An academic background (MSc or PhD) will also be a plus


This is an exciting new project where they are developing an innovative system to automate the client's process using robotics.



As Contractor (PJ), you will have:


  • Competitive compensation (in Reais - R$)
  • Work with international clients with international standards
  • Opportunity to grow as a leader
  • Possibility to move between teams
  • Speak in English with your coworkers
  • 2 weeks of paid leave per year
  • National holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid marriage leave
  • Working with a company that cares about our people and their personal growth
  • All expenses paid for training, conferences, and online courses
  • Remote work
  • Health Care Plan - Online


If you are passionate about technology and have a strong desire to work on cutting-edge projects, we encourage you to apply for this position!


Submit your CV to make sure it contains your LinkedIn and GitHub accounts.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Python Developer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Python Developer to design and implement RESTful APIs, preferably using Litestar. You will integrate with OpenAI APIs and similar third-party services, focusing on authentication, rate limits, retries, and streaming. Your role will involve building robust data ingestion pipelines, including web scraping, parsing, and normalization. You will write clean, maintainable code, participate in code reviews, and manage CI/CD processes. You will own features end-to-end, from scoping to deployment and monitoring.


Requirements:


  • Solid hands-on experience with Python;
  • Strong knowledge of HTTP/REST, JSON, authentication (JWT/OAuth), and API design
  • Experience with OpenAI APIs (or equivalent) and related tooling
  • Web scraping using requests/ BeautifulSoup/lxml, and Playwright/Selenium
  • Data parsing (regex, JSON/CSV), basic pandas
  • Proficiency in SQL (PostgreSQL or similar), ORMs (SQLAlchemy), and Docker
  • Familiarity with typing, linting, and formatting tools (ruff/black)
  • Clear communication skills, reliability, and the ability to manage your own work

Languages:

  • English

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
We are a collective group of fearless people with a clear purpose: to empower professionals around the world through intelligent workflow automation software. Currently, more than 500 people across 7 countries work with us, remotely or in a hybrid way, to make life easier for over 3,000 companies using Pipefy in more than 180 countries. Since our founding in 2015, we have put people at the center of everything we do, so we invite you to learn more about this position and apply to be part of our team.


Job Description:

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Desenvolvedor Python
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) Python — Júnior/Pleno


Remoto • PJ • Tempo integral


Sobre a Guruja


A Guruja Concursos é uma plataforma educacional especializada em preparação para concursos públicos, comprometida em oferecer soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que transformam a jornada de aprendizado dos nossos alunos. 


Sobre a vaga


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Python para integrar nossa equipe de tecnologia. Você será responsável por desenvolver soluções de software robustas e escaláveis, participando ativamente do desenvolvimento e evolução do ecossistema da nossa plataforma educacional.


Responsabilidades


Implementar e manter APIs e serviços Python (FastAPI/Flask), focando em qualidade, performance e segurança.

Modelar e otimizar bancos relacionais e consultas (SQL).Escrever testes, participar de code reviews e documentar o que construir.Colaborar com produto/design/conteúdo para transformar requisitos em soluções simples e escaláveis.


Requisitos


  • Experiência com Python (fundamentos, OOP) e desenvolvimento web/back-end.
  • SQL e bancos relacionais (SQL Server/PostgreSQL/MySQL).
  • Git, código limpo, testável e documentado.
  • Disponibilidade remota em horário comercial, boa comunicação e autonomia.


Diferenciais (valorizamos)


  • FastAPI, Flask ou Django; pytest; Docker; CI/CD.
  • Azure; Redis/Celery/filas; NoSQL (Mongo/Redis).
  • Observabilidade (logs/metrics); experiência em edtech.
  • Vivência com N8N, Power BI Embedded, mensageria (Service Bus).


O que oferecemos


100% remoto, horário comercial com flexibilidade.

Ambiente colaborativo, aprendizado contínuo e impacto real na vida de milhares de estudantes.


Informações


Nível: Júnior a Pleno (1–5 anos)

Regime: PJ • 40h/semana • Brasil (qualquer local)

Valor hora: a combinar.

title: SDR (100% remote)
description:
Mandatory - to complete your application, please visit:


SDR - Lead with Precision and Confidence


Are you an assertive, self-confident, and analytic professional who thrives in high-urgency environments? We are looking for a serious, detail-oriented Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for high-volume outbound prospecting, making calls, sending emails, and using LinkedIn to target facilities managers and maintenance decision-makers.


About WiseVAs

WiseVAs is a premium staffing agency specializing in connecting exceptional remote professionals with businesses seeking top-tier talent. We pride ourselves on our rigorous vetting process and ability to match clients with highly skilled virtual executives.


The Opportunity

As a SDR, you will take charge of outbound prospecting efforts, managing a pipeline of 200-250 daily activities. Your role will focus on making cold calls, navigating gatekeepers, and setting appointments for our closers. Success will be based on your ability to schedule high-quality appointments while managing a strategic outreach approach over a 3-4 month sales cycle.


You will be expected to handle objections professionally, follow a structured process, and ensure that all activities are tracked meticulously. If you are analytical, able to follow rules, and focus on precision and efficiency, we want you to join our team.


Your Responsibilities

  • Make cold calls to facilities managers, navigating gatekeepers and targeting key decision-makers.


  • Manage a high-volume pipeline, following up on leads and ensuring efficient scheduling of appointments.


  • Deliver brief and impactful value propositions to prospects.


  • Schedule appointments for the closing team and ensure timely follow-up on all activities.


  • Track all interactions and maintain organized records in the CRM system.


  • Handle objections in a professional manner, ensuring smooth and productive conversations.


  • Work 40 hours per week, meeting success metrics based on the volume and quality of appointments set.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong English communication skills, with a professional phone demeanor.


  • Previous experience in cold calling and appointment setting.


  • Proven ability to manage a high-volume pipeline and engage in back-and-forth dialogues with prospects.


  • Experience with CRM or tracking systems to manage leads effectively.


  • Reliability to commit to 40 hours per week.


  • No healthcare industry experience required (scripts will be provided).


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You are uncomfortable working in a high-urgency, fast-paced environment.


  • You prefer not to follow structured processes or workflows.


  • You struggle with multi-tasking and managing a large volume of leads.


Apply now:


This is an external position to work at a WiseVAs client. Considering that the management of job positions is entirely handled by the hiring companies, and that WiseVAs operates solely as an intermediary between the candidate and the hiring company, the submission of proposals by candidates does not guarantee employment. Similarly, candidates acknowledge and authorize the storage of resumes and proposals in WiseVAs's database, as well as the receipt of messages, emails, and calls offering new job positions and opportunities.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About Ótmow

Ótmow is a fast-growing fintech startup reshaping financial access for companies that work with the Brazilian government. We empower these businesses with seamless, secure, and accessible financial solutions in order to provide essential government services with confidence.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer who treats AI as a partner, not just a tool. You’ll build end-to-end features across the stack while creatively leveraging AI to accelerate development, automate workflows, and design scalable, flexible systems.

You’ll work in a fast-moving environment focused on transforming complex data into intelligent products. From building a credit matrix and automating sales/marketing workflows to designing dashboards and public-data scrapers, you’ll directly shape Ótmow’s core technology.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain features using React (TypeScript) and Python (FastAPI or Flask) .
  • Collaborate with AI tools (GPT, Claude, Cursor, etc.) to speed up coding, automate tasks, and improve quality.
  • Design and execute web scraping jobs to extract structured data from public transparency portals.
  • Develop and integrate infrastructure on GCP (Cloud Run, Firestore, Firebase Auth) and Supabase (PostgreSQL) .
  • Implement product features such as credit matrices, automation tools, and performance dashboards.
  • Ensure data integrity and quality across systems.
  • Actively participate in architecture design, code reviews, and planning sessions.
  • Experiment with emerging AI models and evaluate their potential for development, automation, and decision support.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript and React .
  • Solid experience with Python and backend frameworks (FastAPI, Flask ).
  • Experience with web scraping (Playwright, BeautifulSoup, requests).
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and version control (Git, CI/CD) .
  • Fluency in AI-assisted development tools such as GPT, Claude, Cursor, etc.
  • Ability to work independently and communicate clearly in a remote setup.
  • Advanced English (for documentation and discussions) and Native Portuguese (for technical and business communication).
  • Ability to work under Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) in Brazil.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience scraping dynamic websites or handling anti-bot systems.
  • Background in data-driven products or credit/fintech platforms.
  • Knowledge of AI APIs or model fine-tuning.
  • Experience automating developer workflows using AI tools.


Why Join Us?

You’ll be part of a company at the intersection of fintech, data, and AI , redefining how public-sector suppliers access credit in Brazil, to build impactful, scalable solutions. And more ...

  • Competitive salary + performance bonuses.
  • Potential for equity participation, sharing in Ótmow’s long-term success.
  • Opportunity to transform a traditional sector with cutting-edge fintech solutions.
  • Flexible hours and remote-friendly culture.
  • Join a collaborative, diverse global team where different backgrounds, perspectives, and ideas drive innovation.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role: Senior Full Stack Developer (Java Spring Boot | Ruby on Rails | Angular)

Experience: 7+ years

Work location: Heredia, Costa Rica & remote for LATAM

English Required: B2+ - C1

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack Developer with deep expertise in Java Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, and Angular to lead complex application development initiatives. The ideal candidate will be a strong technical contributor with a proven track record in building scalable, high-performance systems. While excelling in backend implementation and frontend execution. This role is ideal for a technically strong developer who is ready to expand their impact beyond code delivery into collaborative leadership, stakeholder communication, and architectural decision-making.

Require Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in Java Spring Boot and core Java (OOP, data structures, algorithms).
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails and full-stack web development.
  • Proven experience with Angular and modern frontend technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js).
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and cloud-native development.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, Docker, and deployment automation tools.
  • Effective communication across global teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end development of scalable, secure, and maintainable applications using Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, and Angular .
  • Deliver high-quality code with a strong emphasis on performance, security, and clean architecture .
  • Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, QA teams, and other team members to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Drive technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and standardization across teams.
  • Represent technical solutions and communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executives.
  • Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation strategies in project planning and execution.
  • Contribute to migration projects, system modernization, and platform upgrades with minimal disruption.

title: Cloud Software Engineer
description:
Progress Rail is seeking a motivated and skilled Cloud Engineer to join its dynamic team. This full-time remote position reports directly to the Cloud Manager and plays a key role in designing and maintaining scalable, reliable cloud infrastructure that supports our cutting-edge rail technology solutions. The role requires independent judgment, strong problem-solving abilities, resourcefulness, and the capacity to navigate ambiguity with creativity and initiative. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a solid background in cloud technologies, capable of balancing speed, quality, and cost-effectiveness to meet both customer and business needs.


Job Purpose:

In this role, the candidate is responsible developing & maintaining ETL/ELD ingestion, API, Web and cloud systems, that deliver real time Railroad data to customers.


About us:

As a Caterpillar company, Progress Rail is one of the largest integrated diversified providers of locomotive, freight car and infrastructure solutions and technologies for the global rail industry. Our team's deep industry expertise ensures a commitment to quality through innovative solutions.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and develop new features for Ruby on Rails web application used for software and model simulation management.
  • Maintain and enhance the ETL, web and API systems.
  • Ensure the systems are highly available, scalable, and performant.
  • Work with Amazon AWS services to deploy, monitor, and manage the systems.
  • Collaborate with other engineers to design and implement new features.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the production environment.
  • Optimize the performance of the systems and ensure they meet security standards.
  • Document the design, implementation, and operation of the systems.
  • Architect and maintain front end web applications.


Technical Skill

  • Experience maintaining and developing new features in Ruby on Rails web applications, particularly those used for software and model simulation management.
  • Experience in backend development with a modern programming language such as Python.
  • Proven experience with ETL systems and API microservices development.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Experience building and deploying high-quality front-end web applications in Angular/Vue, React.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with video streaming services.
  • Familiarity with container orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
  • Deep understanding of microservices architecture.
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools.
  • Familiarity with Java SpringBoot.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Redis, MongoDB, Docker, and Websockets.


Required Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.


Language:

Advanced English. Direct interface with global teams. Reporting to a Manager in the US.


Soft Skills:

  • Compatibility with Our Values in Action (Caterpillar Code of Conduct);
  • Autonomy : Being able to manage yourself, deal with a large number of tasks and solve minor problems proactively and responsibly.
  • Communication : Can clearly express ideas, thoughts and concepts in order to influence others or gain support.
  • Problem Solving : Able to carefully analyze situations, understand the details and root causes of problems, and resolve them independently and effectively.
  • Attention to Detail: Capable of thoroughly reviewing and interpreting facts, plans, or projects, contributing to quality assurance and impact analysis.
  • Systemic Thinking: Able to see and understand the bigger picture, identifying processes, departments, and connections, as well as how they impact the final delivery.


What we are offering for this position:

- CLT contract

- Health insurance for you and your dependents

- Dental plan for you and your dependents

- Meal vouchers

- Food voucher

- Life insurance

- Application for discounts on medicines in pharmacies

- Private pension plan

- Extended maternity and paternity leave

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-End Java - Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-End Java Sênior, em parceria com uma das maiores empresas de solução digital, voltada ao e-commerce que tem atuação em mais de 60 anos de história, com mais de 1.000 lojas físicas, 28 centros de distribuição e mais de 33 milhões de produtos no marketplace.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs RESTful robustas e escaláveis utilizando Java e Spring Boot.
  • Implementação de soluções de mensageria com Apache Kafka.
  • Deploy e gerenciamento de aplicações em ambiente Cloud Azure, utilizando Docker e AKS.
  • Desenvolver testes unitários garantindo a qualidade do código.
  • Modelagem e manipulação de bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server) e não relacionais (MongoDB).
  • Implementação de soluções de cache com Redis.
  • Monitoramento e otimização de aplicações utilizando Grafana, Dynatrace e Stack ELK.
  • Participação ativa na esteira de CI/CD utilizando GitHub Actions.
  • Colaboração com o time para definição de arquiteturas e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Mentoria de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior em projetos de grande porte.
  • Domínio em Java e Spring Boot, incluindo Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security e Spring Cloud.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful.
  • Conhecimento em mensageria com Apache Kafka.
  • Experiência com Cloud Azure, Docker e Kubernetes (AKS).
  • Proficiência em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server) e não relacionais (MongoDB).
  • Conhecimento em soluções de cache (Redis).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento (Grafana, Dynatrace, Stack ELK).
  • Domínio em CI/CD utilizando GitHub Actions.
  • Experiência com testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e padrões de projeto.
  • Habilidade em resolução de problemas complexos e otimização de performance.

title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
description:
SEO Specialist

Remote : Latin America

Rate : USD $8-12/hr

Contract Role


SEO/TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • SEO migration - redirection mapping and implementation
  • Knowledge of technical SEO components (canonicalization, XML sitemaps, keyword cannibalization, robots.txt, schema), investigating indexation and crawl errors , conducting site audits
  • Familiarity and applied experience with tools such as Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, SEMRush (other SEO tools like Ahrefs or Moz) and Google Analytics
  • Strong understanding of core SEO concepts such as crawlability, renderability, and indexability, links, keyword research and content
  • Implement on-page optimizations to enhance page/content relevance, meta tags and content for improved search engine performance
  • Understanding of front-end web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Schema Markup
  • Identify strategic opportunities to grow organic traffic across the business

LOCAL SEO:

Google Business profile optimization

Experience in hyperlocal SEO, including location business listing management across online directories

EXPERIENCE:

SEO migrations

Experience doing technical SEO at scale

Experience working with (and analyzing) large amounts of data

Spreadsheets

SOFT SKILLS:

Collaboration

Pro-active problem solving

Ability to work under tight deadlines

Attention to detail

Accountability

Self-motivated

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the opportunity:

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic

environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform. In this role, you will participate in automating

infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications,and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and

scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and

enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a

fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.


work MST or PST hours.



What you get to do every day:

-Participate in an on-call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.

-Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

-Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self-service where possible.

-Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.

-Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.


✅Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux,Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g.,Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)



✨Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in

languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir,java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

-Participate in an on-call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.

-Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

-Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self-service where possible.

-Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.

-Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.


✅Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux,Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g.,Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)

- Experience with software development and automation in

languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir,java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree
